notes: Ecosystem reports are generated hermetically with RY_NO_INSTALLED_LIBRARIES=1; the source audit used installed R libraries.
The ecosystem audit reconciles each hermetic report against finding identities in this ledger, including diagnostics that are absent from production-only reports.

The grid export inventory resolves four ggplot2 RY010 findings for is.unit and is.grob callback values under import(grid). They were unowned in this ledger and are now verified as missing-export false positives; all other identities are unchanged.

The source digest now records the concatenated bytes of all 32 unprefixed root reports in filename order from the complete default-manifest regeneration. The ledger retains its existing reviewed-package coverage.

Unproven factor/new calls discard downstream facts because the callee or skipped arguments may mutate caller bindings. This conservatively reduces coverage by the ten dplyr identities recorded in the Posit ledger, plus six duckplyr RY040 identities in tests/testthat/test-dplyr-count-tally.R:143/144/179/222/223/254. These retain their existing false-positive audit labels; their disappearance is reduced coverage after uncertain factor calls, not individual diagnostic fixes. Required true-positive identities remain covered.

The pinned condition-coercion regeneration produces no tidyverse identity changes. Its source revision is updated to the producing checker commit. The previously stale source_sha256 is corrected to hash all 32 non-Posit root reports in filename order; no report bytes or finding labels are changed by this metadata correction.

The bounded default-parameter false-branch refinement removes two reviewed ggplot2 RY061 false positives at R/geom-boxplot.R:164:19 and :166:7. Only a default-derived type wholly excluded by a false mode predicate is relaxed; explicit class predicates are excluded and reassignment clears the marker. The pinned corpus comparison removes exactly these two identities and adds none; all true-positive identities remain unchanged.

A forwarded parameter default is no longer asserted onto a root-anchored forwarding call when the caller rebinds the forwarded name before it: the manufactured NULL default (and its logical<len=0> condition) is gone, removing the reviewed ggplot2 RY001 false positive at R/bin.R:101:14. Non-anchored call sites keep their previous behavior; all true positives are preserved.

Regenerated after the function-mode call-head lookup change (PR #396): the only identity delta is one RY070 removed from the unaudited rlang root report (tests/testthat/helper-locale.R:134:5, verified false positive in the Posit ledger). Audited-package identities are unchanged; source digest and ry_commit reflect this full default-manifest regeneration.

Class-less opaque typeshed returns now read as class-unknown instead of a proven-empty class vector, so the rlang standalone data-frame check stays silent for them: the reviewed googlesheets4 RY092 false positive at R/sheet_write.R:83:20 is removed. No other identity changes; all 10 true positives are preserved. The stale source_sha256 is replaced with the reproducible value and the recipe is documented in README.md.

RY107 (any-all-scalar-comparison, issue #356) adds exactly one identity across the corpus: glue R/utils.R:32:7, the audited `any(lengths) == 0` parenthesization defect in recycle_columns(). Runtime-verified true positive: `FALSE == 0` is TRUE, so the written guard computes `!any(lengths)` and the zero-length branch never runs, while the same commit writes the intended `any(lengths == 0)` at glue.R:139,191. Value-preserving comparisons (`== 1`, `> 0`, ...) stay silent, keeping diffobj's `!all(diff(x)) == 1L` idiom quiet.

RY106 (ifelse-mode-collapse, #461) adds two owned true positives: hms R/hms.R:218:3 and blob R/format.R:43:10, the exact typed-NA select behind tidyverse/hms#231 (ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, <character>) over an open-world test, runtime-verified as logical(0) for empty x). The googledrive R/drive_mime_type.R:56 len=0 join artifact stays silent: inferred zero lengths are not collapse proofs, so the definite half fires only on literal empty or NA tests. The regeneration also replaces a source_sha256 that had been stale on main since the 0.5.1 vendor reconciliation regenerated ggplot2.root.txt without recomputing the digest; the recorded value now reproduces from the committed 32 non-posit root reports in filename order.

RY109 (self-referential-default, issue #364) adds 10 true positives across 6 packages, each runtime-verified as a default that can only resolve to its own promise and therefore can never evaluate. The dtplyr trio (step-join.R:162 `copy = copy`, tidyeval-across.R:6,20 `j = j`) is the shipped bug upstream fixed in dbe32a6: triggering the default errors. purrr progress-bars.R:56 `caller_env = caller_env()` errors when the stop_input_type branch is reached. The dplyr R/distinct.R:81 and dbplyr R/verb-distinct.R:61 defaults `caller_env = caller_env(2)` shadow rlang's caller_env() with the formal, but neither body consumes the formal, so the calls run when it is missing: the defaults are dead on arrival and would error the moment anyone consumed them (dplyr's sibling `error_call = caller_env()` at distinct.R:82 is a legal cross-formal reference and correctly stays quiet). ggplot2 stat-bindot.R:133 `method = method` (unused in the body; `densitybin(1:3)` runs) and stat-quantilemethods.R:81 `method.args = method.args` (forced through inject), and lubridate's `tz = tz(x)` (parse.r:975, forced on the character branch) and `.select_formats = .select_formats` (guess.r:265, intent was the namespace function, shadowed by the formal) complete the set. Defusing suppression: dbplyr's sql_runif `n = n()` (body verifies the captured default via enquo) stays silent through typeshed captures_promise provenance; in the posit corpus the same mechanism keeps corrr's enquo/{{ }} idioms quiet, while rlang's own defusing tests (test-nse-defuse.R:329,334) warn because their bare enexpr/enquo are defined in-project -- 2 labeled false positives there, and this manifest's ungated rlang root report (rlang has no packages-block entry) gains exactly those two identities. Bare defuser names defined by the project itself are never credited without provenance.

RY108 (seq-defaulted-forward, #463) adds one owned true positive: hms R/hms.R:307:15, the tidyverse/hms#231 defect itself -- the defaulted `to = hms(1)` is validated (`is_hms(to)`), cast, and forwarded without a `missing(to)` check, so `seq(hms(1), length.out = 3)` repeats the default endpoint (three identical values) and a forwarded `by` errors with "too many arguments". The upstream fix (6fec3ad) guards every `to` use with `missing(to)`, exactly the shape the rule's supplied-vs-defaulted flow analysis recognizes; seq.Date (no default on `to`, cached mTo tests) and the other seq.* methods in the corpus stay silent.

Metadata hygiene (#475): the dbplyr RY091 identities tests/testthat/test-backend-.R:110:36 (`ifelse(x, 1L)`, missing `no`) and test-translate-sql-string.R:13:36 (`substr("test", 0)`, missing `stop`) are each recorded twice because the committed hermetic report emits each diagnostic twice at the same span (both calls sit inside the NSE-capturing expect_translation_snapshot helper). ecosystem/reconcile.R compares report and ledger multisets, so both copies are pinned; the 88-finding total and the pr195-nse-stubs count of 6 include the repeats.

NULL union members now propagate into RY001 condition analysis (#362), adding exactly one reviewed true-positive identity under the new ry001-null-union group (true_positive 24 -> 25): lubridate R/accessors-day.r:98:7, as_week_start's implicit fall-through NULL (an unmatched day name skips every pmatch/match guard) reaching `if (start != 7)` — R errors with "argument is of length zero", runtime-verified. No other identity changes.

RY111 (constant-argument-shadowing, issue #361) adds 11 reviewed findings, all true positives. The founding defect is included: haven R/labelled.R:111 -- median.haven_labelled hardcodes `na.rm = TRUE` behind its own `na.rm = TRUE, ...` formals, so a caller's explicit na.rm = FALSE is silently ignored (runtime-verified in the issue: median(labelled(c(1:4, NA), c(a = 1)), na.rm = FALSE) returns 2.5 where base median returns NA). The other ten are the dbplyr sql_render.*_query methods (union, set_op, semi_join, rf_join, multi_join), whose own `subquery` formal is never read in the method body while the generic (sql_render.lazy_query) forwards the caller's flag into them -- the documented ORDER BY-in-subquery handling is silently dropped for these query types. The rule's dead-formal gate keeps every deliberate corpus idiom silent (dbplyr's select_query forwards `subquery = subquery` at its own wrapper, stringr guards `if (ignore_case)` before its fixed regex(), tibble forwards `quiet = quiet` at the user-facing call, dplyr branches on `recursive`, rvest reads `inherit` inside env_has). One unaudited identity also appears in the regenerated jsonlite report (R/stop.R:2, `call. = FALSE`): jsonlite's own stop wrapper exists precisely to suppress the call in error output, so the dead `call.` formal is deliberate; jsonlite carries no packages entry in this ledger, so the identity is explained here rather than as a finding row.

Dplyr schema effects (#353) remove the two reviewed RY060 false positives at pinned dplyr d5e94e7 tests/testthat/test-group-by.R:26:16 and :40:16: group_by(big = <expression>) creates big before out$big is read. Literal verb effects and conservative unknown/custom S3 fallbacks were checked against the full pinned hermetic corpus; no identity was added and all reviewed true positives remain.

RY032 scalar-flow correction (#351, PR #605): the only reviewed tidyverse identity removed is purrr@481e829 R/deprec-prepend.R:34:7 (unowned, historical plan-32-33 group). Its earlier base stopifnot(is.null(before) || (before > 0 && before <= n)) rejects a length-two before value at the inner && before the later || can run, so the former warning was a false positive. The pinned source, R runtime witness, and adjacent shadowed-operator, effectful-promise, and vector-error controls back this one-row delta; the purrr RY109 identity and every other ledger identity remain. The 32 hermetic non-Posit root reports were hashed in filename order after removing this one line from purrr.root.txt.

delayedAssign bindings and purrr NA widening (#349, #352, PR #628): the reviewed identities removed are dplyr R/conditions.R:310:14 (P4b false positive) and lubridate R/vctrs.R:64/107/112/117 (unowned, plan-32-33), which read delayedAssign() bindings, and purrr tests/testthat/test-map.R:82:20 and test-parallel.R:120:20 (P8 false positives), map_chr(NA, ...) calls that purrr widens to NA_character_. No identity is added; every true positive remains.

local() deferred captures and package base lookup (#568, PR stacked on #628): no ledger identity changes. The unowned cli and rlang reports lose their local()-block RY010 false positives (cli R/defer.R and R/errors.R, rlang R/import-standalone-defer.R), whose closures read helpers the enclosing local() block assigns later. Resolving base switch() in import-free package R/ code adds no identity.

Project-defined call validation (PR #659): RY090/RY091 now check calls whose callee is the project's own single reachable definition. Two true positives are added, both in error-expecting tests, under the new test-fixture group shared with the Posit ledger: ggplot2 tests/testthat/test-utilities.R:108:25 (remove_missing(na.rm = 1:5) omits the forced df) and googledrive tests/testthat/test-drive_create.R:21:19 (drive_create() omits name inside expect_snapshot(error = TRUE)). No identity is removed; every true positive remains.

Package-aware call-head selection (PR #668) removes exactly 13 unowned identities from both production-only and root reports, with no additions or changes to reviewed findings or labels. At testthat@50a99ec76fed8140a9211ed862289e877e86614d, R/import-standalone-types-check.R:125:7, :295:9, :320:9, :345:9, :370:9, :395:9, :420:9, :445:9, :473:9, :498:9, and :523:9 lose RY031: rlang::is_null returns a scalar logical, not testthat's same-named function-valued expectation factory in R/old-school.R. R/reporter-debug.R:61:7 loses RY001 for the corresponding rlang::is_false predicate versus testthat's is_false factory. The executable predicate-factory oracle verifies the R behavior. At jsonlite@0134cba18366b1c51c6497f4f97273a8423d8d86, R/stop.R:2:27 loses RY111: base::stop selects base's variadic contract rather than the 'call.' formal of jsonlite's own wrapper; this is the deliberate wrapper already explained in the #361 note. All 11 reviewed RY111 true positives in haven and dbplyr remain. The source digest covers the complete 32-package default-manifest regeneration.

RY091 must-force walk (#685): the only identity removed is googledrive tests/testthat/test-drive_create.R:21:19 (true_positive, test-fixture), drive_create() with `name` omitted. R does error there, but through rlang::check_required(name) inside the `type` guard at R/drive_create.R:82-85, which ry does not model; ry's only evidence that `name` is forced was the member name in `name <- tmp$name` at R/drive_create.R:95, the `$` field-name misread #685 removes (rewriting that line to tmp[["name"]] silences the pre-fix binary too). The finding was right for the wrong reason, so it is dropped rather than kept by restoring the misread. No identity is added; every other reviewed finding and label remains, and the Posit ledger is unchanged.

RY033 limited to ordering comparisons (#699): `==`/`!=` between a character value and a non-character value compare the formatted strings, so RY033 now fires only for `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`. One reviewed false positive disappears: duckplyr R/fallback.R:75:21 (P8, `Sys.getenv("DUCKPLYR_FALLBACK_INFO") == TRUE`). No identity is added; every true positive remains.

RY040 literal NULL beside a dispatchable operand (#707): a literal NULL arithmetic operand now reports only when the other operand is NULL or a known atomic without a class attribute. The two identities removed are both P7a false positives: ggplot2 tests/testthat/test-geom-curve.R:17:8, a ggplot(df) + geom_curve(...) chain ending in `+ NULL` (line 46) that ggplot2's S7 `+` methods (R/plot-construction.R:66-74) accept, and glue tests/testthat/test-glue.R:595:20, as_glue("hello") + NULL, which dispatches to +.glue (R/glue.R:387) and is expected to return character(). No identity is added; every true positive remains, and the P7a group stays at zero.

Block-frame closures shadow base stubs (#718): a `name <- function(...)` bound inside an R6Class() member list, a local() block or a testthat block is now a lexical callable, as in a plain function body. Three reviewed false positives disappear, all dplyr P4a (the #350 sites): R/data-mask.R:112:7, R/data-mask.R:117:7 and R/data-mask.R:131:7, RY091 `eval()` missing `expr` where the R6 method calls its own local `eval` closure. No identity is added and every true positive remains; the Posit ledger drops the same three identities (function-shadowing).

If-arm bindings merge wherever the if sits (#694): an `if` used as a value and an `if` ending a `{}` block or braced call argument now merge their arm bindings into the enclosing frame like a statement `if`. One reviewed false positive disappears: dplyr R/summarise.R:342:34 (P4c, the #350 site), RY010 on `group_sizes`, which both arms of the `if` ending withCallingHandlers({...}) bind. No identity is added and every true positive remains; the Posit ledger drops the same identity plus three blogdown and tinytex false positives.

S3 dispatcher bindings (#348): a helper registered with registerS3method()/.S3method() inside a top-level evalqOnLoad() block, when it is the name's only global literal, now binds .Generic, .Class, .Method, and .Group like any S3 method. Two unowned identities disappear (plan-32-33): lubridate R/ops-compare.r:20:64 and :55:14, RY010 on `.Generic` in comp_posix_date, which evalqOnLoad registers as the Date/POSIXt comparison method (getS3method("<", "Date") resolves to it). No identity is added and every true positive remains.

Top-level on_load() blocks bind package names (#691): plain assignments in a top-level rlang-style on_load({...}) block are now package bindings. No ledger identity changes; the ungated rlang reports lose five RY010 false positives, R/cnd-abort.R:855:10, R/env-special.R:220:16, and R/trace.R:1082:8, :1094:16 and :1096:16 (has_cli_format, base_pkg_env, has_cli_start_app, which rlang binds in on_load() blocks). The Posit ledger drops 46 reviewed false positives (namespace-on-load).
